{{Current events|year=2022|month=04|day=17|content=
<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Siege of Mariupol]]
****The [[Russian Armed Forces]] give an ultimatum to the last remaining holdout of [[Ukrainian Ground Forces|Ukrainian troops]] and "foreign fighters" at the [[Azovstal iron and steel works]] plant in [[Mariupol]] to surrender. Defenders of the [[Azov Sea]] port ignore the ultimatum. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-sets-0300-gmt-deadline-ukraine-troops-mariupol-surrender-2022-04-17/ (Reuters)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/4/17/russian-ultimatum-to-ukraine-forces-in-mariupol-expires (Al Jazeera)]
***[[2022 Ukrainian refugee crisis]]
****For the first time since the invasion began, more [[Ukrainians]] entered Ukraine from [[Poland]] than left, according to the [[Polish Border Guard]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/live/world-europe-61136997?pinned_post_locator=urn:asset:ee08691e-8722-40df-bf4b-c06d945eea33&pinned_post_asset_id=625c9c9c77811a20d37c8da4 (BBC News)]
***Six people are killed by Russian missile strikes on [[Lviv]]. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/ukraine-war-russia-missile-lviv-deaths-b2059964.html (''Independent'')]
*[[Insurgency in the Maghreb]]
**[[Jihadist insurgency in Niger]]
***More than 70 [[Islamic State – West Africa Province]] [[militant]]s are killed during [[airstrike]]s by [[Niger]] and [[Nigeria]] at the [[Niger–Nigeria border|border between the two countries]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/4/17/nigeria-army-says-70-terrorists-killed-in-operation (Al Jazeera)]

'''Business and economy'''
*American [[conspiracy theory|conspiracy theorist]] website ''[[InfoWars]]'' files for [[Chapter 11, Title 11, United States Code|Chapter 11 bankruptcy]] due to mounting legal fees from lawsuits over its spread of [[Sandy Hook Elementary School shooting conspiracy theories|conspiracy theories]] about the [[Sandy Hook Elementary School shooting]]. [https://www.npr.org/2022/04/18/1093297017/infowars-bankruptcy-alex-jones-sandy-hook-shooting-defamation (NPR)] 

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
***The [[Australian Government|government]] withdraws its ban on foreign [[cruise ship]]s. [https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/australasia/article/3174548/coronavirus-australias-pandemic-era-ban-cruise-ships-comes (''South China Morning Post'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[North Korea and weapons of mass destruction]]
**[[North Korea]] says that it tested a new weapon to boost their [[tactical nuclear weapon|tactical nuclear]] capabilities. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-61133225 (BBC News)]
 
'''Law and crime'''
*[[2022 Pittsburgh shooting]]
**Two people are killed and 13 more injured in a [[mass shooting]] at a party in [[Pittsburgh]], [[Pennsylvania]], [[United States]]. [https://apnews.com/article/crime-shootings-pittsburgh-1e2c7890500b729ca76610b47d8e5769 (AP)]
*[[Myanmar]]'s [[Military rule in Myanmar|military junta]] pardons 1,619 prisoners in an annual tradition. However, no [[Political prisoners in Myanmar|political prisoners]] were pardoned. [https://www.france24.com/en/asia-pacific/20220417-myanmar-junta-frees-1-600-from-jail-but-not-political-prisoners (France24)]
*Around 70 [[Extinction Rebellion]] members, including canoeist [[Etienne Stott]] and sailor [[Laura Baldwin (sailor)|Laura Baldwin]], are detained after gluing themselves to a [[Shell plc|Shell]] [[Tank truck|oil tanker truck]] near the [[Marble Arch]] at [[Hyde Park, London|Hyde Park]] in [[London]], [[UK]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-london-61133235 (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Citizen Lab]]'s research reveals at least 65 pro-[[Catalan independence movement|independence]] [[Catalans|Catalan]] figures - including [[Pere Aragonès]] and [[Carles Puigdemont]] - have been targeted using [[NSO Group]]’s [[Pegasus (spyware)|Pegasus]] [[spyware]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/apr/18/catalan-leaders-targeted-using-nso-spyware-say-cybersecurity-experts (''The Guardian'')]

'''Sports'''
*[[2022 Nippon Professional Baseball season]], [[Rōki Sasaki's perfect game]]
**[[Chiba Lotte Marines]] pitcher [[Rōki Sasaki]] is taken out after throwing 102 pitches and eight perfect innings to end his attempt for a second consecutive [[Perfect game (baseball)|perfect game]], one week after [[Rōki Sasaki's perfect game|completing his first one]]. [https://www.mlb.com/news/roki-sasaki-perfect-for-8-innings (MLB.com)]
